I will put chemical fertilizer on this plot, but not too much because this piece is very small and I have other fields to cover as well. I went to school some, so I look at cost and return, and on maize I do better when I use improved seed with a bit of fertilizer; I also add manure here because the plot is near home and easy to carry to. I will depend on the rains, and I will manage weeds with family work instead of paying for spray or hired people on this small piece.
